blocks.text: The University of the Visayas (UV) Green Lancers cemented their hold of the No. 2 spot ahead of the Final Four of the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men's basketball tournament after grabbing an easy 100-73 win over the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons on Saturday, November 21, at the UV Main Campus gymnasium....
